Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Question on lead credits from May 1 webinar

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for running the May 1 'AI Ops for Healthcare' webinar — turnout was solid from a sponsor perspective. Our finance team reviewed the lead list you provided and flagged a discrepancy: 18 leads you marked as "sourced to Cloudwave" in your post-event report appear in our CRM under direct Cloudwave outreach from April (pre-webinar).

Cloudwave's sponsorship agreement includes a 90-day exclusivity window for new leads introduced via the webinar funnel. Because some of these contacts already existed in our system, we are asking for a reclassification or an earnback credit for 12 of the 18. Can you share how Redwood deduplicated and timestamped the lead ingestion? Specifically:

- Raw exported lead file (all timestamps)
- Matching rules used (email, company, fuzzy name)
- Any manual overrides applied during reconciliation

We need this by EOD Monday to close our reconciliation. If you prefer a quick call instead of documents, I'm available Mon 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
Anna

--
Anna Lee
Sponsorship Operations Manager
Cloudwave Media
anna@cloudwavemedia.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna@cloudwavemedia.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on lead credits from May 1 webinar

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and sorry for the stress here. We're digging into the matching now. Quick context for how we generated the post-event report:

- Lead ingestion: raw registration CSV (timestamped at registration time) + platform joins (attendee > registration ID)
- Matching heuristics: exact email match first, then company + name fuzzy match (Levenshtein threshold 0.85), then manual review for VIPs
- Overrides: one manual override was made for an enterprise contact (Row 412) where the email alias differed; we flagged that in the audit log.

Action items from our side:
1) We'll push the raw ingestion CSV (with registration timestamps) and the matching log by EOD Monday.
2) Priyom will run a dedupe pass with a stricter rule set (email only) and produce a side-by-side reconciliation showing which contacts flip classification.
3) Tessa and I will review any contacts that appear to be pre-existing but have webinar attendance within 7 days of last-touch to avoid mis-crediting retargeted outreach.

If you have specific CRM IDs (Cloudwave's), send them and Priyom will match 1:1. Otherwise we'll send our internal IDs and the mapping. Appreciate the call offer — let's keep it asynchronous unless we hit blockers.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Question on lead credits from May 1 webinar

Hi Anna — following up with the first pass attached.

I've uploaded two files to the Drive link (shared above):
- mutual-action-plan_20260507.xlsx — proposed cadence to resolve disputed credits across 3 buckets (confirmed new, likely duplicate, needs manual review)
- Cloudwave_PostEvent_Attachments.zip — raw export, matched list, and the timestamped audit log.

Summary of findings (first pass):
- 18 flagged contacts: 6 are clear pre-existing matches (identical email and CRM ID).
- 7 appear to be bouncebacks/marketing list members collected by Cloudwave in late April (they registered for the webinar after a nurture email on Apr 27). Their "first seen" date in Cloudwave's CRM is Apr 28 in many cases — we'll mark these as "nurture-origin" and suggest split credit.
- 5 are new in both systems and should remain credited to Cloudwave per the sponsorship terms.

Proposal: for the 7 nurture-origin contacts, apply a 60/40 credit split for pipeline attribution (60% Cloudwave, 40% Redwood) and issue a partial earnback credit equal to the lead contribution agreed in the SOW. We put suggested journal entries in row 12 of the MAP.

Next steps:
- Priyom will run the strict email-only dedupe and return a final reconciled CSV by EOD Fri.
- Ben will confirm pipeline lift (SQL/Oppty) linked to these contacts and propose any credit adjustments for closed-won deals that used those leads.
- Anna/Contracts to confirm whether a full earnback is required for the 6 clear pre-existing contacts (we expect Cloudwave to accept reclassification).

If it's helpful, propose a 30-minute wrap-up on Mon to sign off.

Thanks,
Tessa

--

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the transparency. I've reviewed the MAP and the drive exports; this workflow looks fair. A couple of quick notes before we lock the earnback:

- Cloudwave will accept reclassification for the 6 clear pre-existing contacts and waive the earnback for those.
- For the 7 nurture-origin contacts, our finance lead wants the 60/40 split documented on official letterhead and the partial credit to appear on May invoices as a line-item (we'll route a DocuSign if needed).
- For the 5 new contacts where Cloudwave retains full credit, please confirm any downstream conversions tied to Redwood outreach (we'll need to see at least the deal IDs and close dates).

I'll have Contracts prepare the simple amendment for the partial credit and route it early next week. Happy to do the Mon 30-min signoff — target Mon 10:30 PT.

Anna
